kind: Read-only SpO2 upload, verifier and legacy pending-journal review; recovery-entry implementation; no user-account write or device test

limits: No new health upload occurred in this run. Successful reads did not return a matching active default-SID target for the pending identities.
Only three missing targets were independently sampled by narrower queries; their absence does not establish a complete server search or prove non-persistence.
The earlier 219/72/147 and current 195/63/132 counts describe different selected sets. Zero newly-verified/probe-verified rows does not support a claim that fifteen pending rows were recovered.

upload_contract.native_point: Spo2Item serializes time as Long seconds and spo2 as Int percentage; current mapper follows this shape.
upload_contract.native_upload: FitnessDataRequest.uploadFitnessData builds UploadFitnessDataParam(phoneId, List<FitnessDataModel>) and serializes it for data/up_fitness_data.
upload_contract.native_result: FitnessApiService declares BaseResult<DataBooleanResult>; FitnessDataRequest returns DataBooleanResult.getResult(): Boolean. No per-row acceptance or server transaction guarantee was established.
upload_contract.comparison_result: The original author's importer also uses sid=default, key=spo2, seconds in both outer/inner time, a JSON string value, zone_offset and deleted=false. It fixes zone_name to Asia/Shanghai; our HC importer leaves zone_name empty because an offset does not identify an IANA zone. This difference is not a demonstrated cause of the user's missing records.
upload_contract.finding: No proven SpO2 field-encoding error was found that explains the 132 missing pending targets. Do not alter actual measurement values, source times or SID to manufacture a verification result.

legacy_pending_findings.write_order: MiHealthImportRunner persists pending before POST. Explicit business rejection also retains pending unless later readback verifies the target.
legacy_pending_findings.missing_outcome_history: Accepted-but-unverified, explicitly rejected, response-lost and write-not-started-after-journal are not distinguishable from the legacy stored pending entry.
legacy_pending_findings.fingerprint_limit: The legacy content fingerprint covers row.value, not zoneOffsetSeconds. Target identity also omits the offset. The source digest hashes package:recordId keys, not the complete source revision. Matching legacy identity/content/source digests cannot prove byte-equivalence of the original complete request.
legacy_pending_findings.global_reset_limit: resetPendingImports removes retry locks across the ledger; it does not establish remote absence, make requests idempotent or preserve a per-target consumed recovery budget. It must not be used as an automatic recovery step.

same_classification: No matching key/time target was returned.
Rows with the same key/time exist only under a different explicit SID.
The expected SID/key/time appears only as deleted=true.
legacy_missing_semantics.unknown_sid: A same-key/time active row with missing or blank SID becomes AMBIGUOUS, not MISSING.
legacy_missing_semantics.recovery_requirement: Recovery must inspect returned rows for tombstones, different-source occupancy and ambiguous identity instead of treating verifier MISSING alone as sufficient authorization to resend. A deleted observation must not silently become a new default record.

entry_points.phone: The main App exposes an explicit one-pending-SpO2 recovery action using the same recovery flow as the device-test entry.
entry_points.failure_behavior: No automatic command repetition; prechecks or exhausted recovery budget may produce zero health uploads. No global pending reset.
entry_points.session: Use existing App login and Health Connect grants; the instrumentation process gate continues to suppress normal sync and home-profile refresh.

limitations: One successful recovery does not establish that all remaining pending rows can be replayed safely or that the official Mi Fitness App has displayed them.
A stable client target identity is not evidence of server-side exactly-once or upsert semantics.
A local fingerprint cannot reconstruct fields that old versions did not persist.
Authentication refresh and data-read requests can use HTTP POST without constituting a health-data mutation; distinguish attempted health rows from raw HTTP request counts.
